column1: # The masks of the UI refresh's galleries and of the window checks' check U0 (docs/port-notes/UI-0a.md; docs/specs/ui-refresh-plan.md, section 8).
# Each row is a rectangle of the matching pictures that changes from run to run: the clock, a date, the scratch copy's database name (winchk_
# and a time stamp), and a few values of the machine at that moment. tools/New-UiGallery.ps1 and the check U0 leave these pixels out of the
# masked pixel SHA-256, the share of changed pixels and the difference picture (one rule: tools/UiGallery/UiPictureMask.cs). The pictures
# themselves are shown as they are.
#   picture  a wildcard (* and ?, any case); without a slash it matches the file name, with one the path relative to the picture folder
#   size     * for any size, or WIDTHxHEIGHT: the row applies only to pictures of that size (the gallery lists a row whose name matches
#            and whose size does not, so a window that changed size gets its row looked at)
#   anchor   top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right: the corner x and y are measured from
#   x, y     pixels from that corner's two edges to the rectangle's nearest sides
#   width, height  the rectangle's size in pixels
# Coordinates are device pixels of the harness's pictures at 100 % (96 DPI), measured on the WINCHK-5 pictures (2026-11-16). UI-0c added
# the row of group U's main window in the Appointments module (UM*-appts*.png, at 1366x768 and 1920x1080, with and without a patient; the
# module is paged to 2026-11-09, so only its date panel moves with the day). Group U's walker writes masks-suggested.tsv into the results
# folder's ui-walker folder: the rectangles of its pictures that show today's date or the clock, in this format, for the lead to check
# against the pictures of the before set and add here (docs/port-notes/UI-0c.md).
